title: Runway

closed.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

displaced_threshold_ft.description: The threshold's displacement from the runway's end, feet (NASR APT_RWY_END). A landing on this end has the runway past it (AIM 2-3-3); a takeoff has the whole length.

lda_ft.description: The landing distance available the airport declares for this end, feet (AC 150/5300-13B, declared distances); where given, a landing is judged against it.

description: A runway as the planner sends one.
